## Highlights

The first public release of RillDisk: a native, GPU-rendered disk analyzer with a CLI and an MCP server, built in Rust for Windows, macOS and Linux.

- **See where the space went.** A dashboard with a treemap and a rings chart, largest files, file types and search, rendered with your GPU. It stays responsive on drives with tens of millions of files.
- **Know what you can free.** Clean up finds rebuildable build output (`target`, `node_modules`, `.next`, Unity `Library`...), package caches (npm, pnpm, pip, Cargo, Go, NuGet, Gradle...), temp folders, and old Git or AI-agent worktrees (Claude Code, Codex, T3 Code, Cursor). Each one comes with a reason and a command you can run.
- **Honest numbers.** Logical size, on-disk size and hard links counted once are kept apart. Partial scans, unreadable folders and cancelled scans are always shown, never hidden.
- **For AI assistants too.** `rilldisk mcp` gives Claude, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients the same read-only view: scans, largest folders, cleanup candidates, file types.
- **Proper installers for every system.** MSI for Windows (x64 and ARM64), `.dmg` for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), `.deb`, `.rpm` and AppImage for Linux (x86_64 and aarch64), and a static command-line build for servers and Alpine. Each one is installed and tested before it is published.
- **Safe updates.** The app checks once a day if you allow it, verifies every download with SHA-256, and never overwrites files your package manager owns. Set `RILLDISK_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to turn checks off.
- **Private by design.** RillDisk reads file names and sizes, never file contents. It sends nothing about you or your files anywhere.
